theme_central: Denying the Judgment manifests very concretely: neglecting the orphan and the poor, praying without sincerity, refusing the simplest mutual help.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: Neglect of the orphan and the poor
branches.resume: Whoever denies the Judgment repels the orphan and does not urge the feeding of the poor.

children.t: Neglect of the orphan and the poor, sign of denying the Judgment

branches.title: Hypocritical prayer, refusal of mutual help
branches.resume: Woe to the heedless, ostentatious worshippers, who refuse the simplest mutual help.

children.t: Hypocritical, ostentatious prayer, refusal of ordinary mutual help
